rules.topic: which database, schema or tables a service owns, reads or writes
rules.requirement: Each microservice owns its data. No service reads or writes another service's database.

rules.topic: a request/response call one service makes to another service or an external API
rules.requirement: Every synchronous call has a timeout and a fallback.

rules.topic: correlation or trace IDs carried on requests and messages
rules.requirement: Every request and message carries a correlation ID.

sections: The loyalty service awards points when an order is paid. Finance needs a monthly points report.
Loyalty keeps balances in its own loyalty schema. To build the monthly report it reads the orders table of the order service directly.
Loyalty calls the customer service over HTTP to look up the tier. The call times out after 800 ms and falls back to the standard tier.
Every HTTP request and every event carries the X-Correlation-Id header, which is copied into all log lines.
